chunks: And those whose (deeds) are lighter in the scale shall perish for violating Our signs.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people whose scales will be light on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the principle of 'self-inflicted loss' (khusr al-anfus), where the 'lightness' of the scales reflects a deficiency in both the quantity and quality of deeds, often due to neglecting the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt. The phrase 'they wronged themselves' (yazlimun) is interpreted not merely as omission but as an active distortion of divine truth, linking their spiritual failure to a rejection of the clear signs (ayat) that establish the path to salvation.
